overview: A premium, single-page cinematic landing website for the sports team "Bloody Unicorns" — dark theme, deep red accents, heavy motion design, and scroll-triggered animations to create a high-energy, intimidating sports brand feel.
features: Cinematic full-screen hero with animated logo, taglines, and CTA buttons
Animated stat counters that trigger on scroll
Squad player card grid with hover glow and tilt effects
Dramatic Rivalry section with red accent styling
Media placeholder cards with Instagram redirect
Sponsors/Partners logo grid with placeholder branding
Smooth scroll-based animations throughout all sections
